projects.title: Industrial Circular Economy & Resource Recovery Framework
projects.summary: Comprehensive material flow balance and resource recovery modeling designed to eliminate industrial effluents and cycle byproducts back into manufacturing streams.
projects.description: Applied industrial sustainability assessment across manufacturing streams, evaluating closed-loop resource recovery potential and establishing verifiable ESG benchmarks for waste minimization.
keyContributions: Quantified industrial byproduct reuse streams across manufacturing operations
Designed closed-loop flow diagrams aligned with ESG benchmarks
Formulated lifecycle impact assessment methodologies for waste reduction
outcomes: Designed closed-loop flow diagrams aligned with ESG benchmarks
projects.problemStatement: Linear manufacturing models generate byproduct waste streams and face escalating environmental compliance and disposal costs.
objectives: Map material inputs and waste outputs across industrial manufacturing lines
Identify feasible closed-loop byproduct recovery pathways
Align resource efficiency metrics with national and international ESG standards
projects.methodology: Mass balance accounting, material flow analysis (MFA), and industrial closed-loop recycling frameworks.
projects.implementation: Evaluated manufacturing streams across group companies, cataloging recyclable byproducts and assessing secondary utilization.
projects.results: Identified potential byproduct reuse opportunities and established verifiable ESG tracking metrics.

projects.title: Refinery Gasoline Isomerization Unit Process Study
projects.summary: Process engineering analysis on the catalytic isomerization unit at Attock Oil Refinery Limited (ARL), evaluating octane enhancement and hydrocarbon feedstock flow.
projects.description: Engineering study of light naphtha isomerization unit operations for high-octane gasoline blending, reviewing PFDs/P&IDs, reaction kinetics, and occupational plant safety protocols.
keyContributions: Inspected light naphtha catalytic isomerization flow diagrams and reactor parameters
Assisted in monitoring hydrocarbon feedstock processing and product quality testing
Observed occupational safety protocols and hazard control in active refinery zones
outcomes: Conducted process analysis on gasoline isomerization unit
Assisted in optimizing hydrocarbon feedstock flow and laboratory quality testing
projects.problemStatement: Optimizing light naphtha conversion to high-octane gasoline blending components while maintaining strict catalyst activity and safety standards.
objectives: Understand reaction thermodynamics and catalyst regeneration cycles in isomerization
Analyze unit operational parameters (temperature, pressure, hydrogen-to-hydrocarbon ratio)
Assist senior engineers with product sampling and octane rating quality checks
projects.methodology: Process flow diagram (PFD) and P&ID tracing, unit operation material balances, and laboratory fuel testing analysis.
projects.implementation: Field walkthroughs, control room parameter logging, and laboratory octane rating coordination at ARL.
projects.results: Gained verified foundational expertise in crude distillation, catalytic isomerization, and refinery process hazard control.
